verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's docs say all /api endpoints use private API keys with API key scopes, that scopes limit what third parties can access, and that a "Custom" option lets you decide how much access to grant. OAuth is also offered for app integrations, and the API supports pulling data for analysis and dashboards. Missing for 10: an explicit read-only scope or preset, documentation showing reporting/analytics read scopes separated from campaign/send permissions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
